title: helenium viscosum
intro: Helenium viscosum, commonly known as Sticky False Hemp or Sticky Helenium, is a perennial plant native to the southeastern United States. It is used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Helenium viscosum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, working together to reduce inflammation, relieve pain, and support immune function. Additionally, it is believed to have antioxidant and vulnerary properties, making it a potential remedy for wounds and skin conditions.
